## Documentation

**Generated by:** oc-docs-forge (this session)
**Docs changed:** `CLAUDE.md` (CI section: LHCI preview server; deploy flow: stale-baseline warning and the Deploy lag issue behaviour), `docs/runbooks/cloudflare-challenge.md` (Interpreting failures: what Deploy lag and `npm run deploy` now do on a mismatch), `docs/runbooks/release-tag-backfill.md` (new; draft procedure for issue #464).
**Reader impact:** An operator who deploys sees the baseline obligation at the moment it starts instead of four days later in a red scheduled run. A contributor editing `skills/` gets the generated mirrors regenerated by the commit hook. The LHCI gate now covers all seven routes at error level with a 0.04 margin restored on Best Practices.
**Follow-up docs:** None required. The release-tag backfill runbook is a draft for the maintainer to execute; the issue links back to it once run.
